news.title: Leaders call for coordinated action as Australia’s social licence shows cracks
news.summary_en: Public confidence in Australia’s international education sector is under pressure, with leaders warning that social licence can no longer be treated as someone else's problem.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: University College Birmingham unveils £15m hospitality expansion
news.summary_en: The university has said the £15 million investment will create more than 150 jobs while giving students paid work, placements and hands-on experience in live commercial environments, as UK universities face growing pressure to deliver stronger career outcomes.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Australia has policy. Where is the strategy?
news.summary_en: Neil Fitzroy argues that before asking international students to make their case for Australia, Australia must be prepared to make its case to them.
news.author: Neil Fitzroy

news.title: US: Trump administration considers $100,000 OPT fee
news.summary_en: The Trump administration is reportedly weighing a plan to fix a $100,000 fee onto America’s post-graduation employment program for international students known as Optional Practical Training (OPT).
news.author: Polly Nash
